name: AutoGPT
description: Builds, deploys and runs continuous autonomous agents through a low-code block-based builder, the project that popularized the autonomous-agent loop.

skills.name: Block Agent Builder

skills.name: Continuous Execution

skills.name: Goal Decomposition
